verdict.rationale: The project explicitly documents that any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works, naming self-hostable servers such as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp and Ollama alongside cloud APIs. The app lists the endpoint's models or accepts a manual model ID, with separate planner and actor models, so the agent can run against a locally hosted model instead of a cloud API. Missing for 10: no on-device (on-phone) model option, no guidance on which local vision models perform adequately, no detail on networking a local server to the phone, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of local-model runs.
